description: Pre-execution approval for AI coding agents (Claude Code today; Codex and Cursor planned) — blocks dangerous operations before they run. Sees nothing else.

velar.securityAdvisory: 0.3.0 fixes a silent default-allow gap: any tool call classify.ts couldn't recognize (this affected WebFetch/WebSearch, and would affect any future built-in tool Claude Code adds) previously passed through unmonitored. It also adds velar-self-protection, a critical-risk rule blocking writes to Velar's own hook config and vendored code. Existing installs stay on the vendored version from their last `velar init` until it's re-run — see `velar doctor` for an upgrade check. Upgrade: npx @velar-dev/cli@latest init
